name: MiniMax
tagline: Multimodal foundation models and developer API for text, code, video, speech, and music.
description: MiniMax is a Shanghai foundation-model lab whose platform serves its own model family through a developer API and agent app: the M-series LLMs (M2/M3) built for coding and agentic workflows with up to a 1M-token context, the Hailuo video models, and MiniMax Speech and Music. Developers get chat completions, text-to-speech, and text-to-video on token-based pricing, with a free agent tier for getting started.
insight: Open-weighted its M-series LLMs — M2, a 230B-param MoE, shipped Oct 2025 at roughly 8% of Claude Sonnet's per-token price.
edge: Frontier-class coding and agent models (M-series, 1M-token context) at a fraction of US-lab API prices, with open weights to self-host.
cons: Docs less mature than US incumbents

references.title: Chinese LLM firm MiniMax launches Hong Kong IPO, targets Jan. 9 debut
